topic: How HTTPS keeps your data private

request.notes: Pure motion graphics on a clean corporate background (the style's plain light field): no cinematic sets, no hand-drawn or textured look, no presenter. Mostly the system itself in motion: a browser and a server, data packets travelling, a certificate being checked, keys being exchanged, data scrambled and unscrambled, the padlock. Technical but clean and beautiful: crisp shapes, clear labels, purposeful motion. Any engine library may be used where it serves the idea.
